raw_evidence.distribution: Local only; excluded from Git. Regression tests and this summary do not require the raw evidence directory.

raw_evidence.contents: Unchanged raw logs, origins, commands, pair data, profiles, source variants and full-results.json; RELOCATION.md explains historical path prefixes.

human_decisions.mass_view: Leave mass view out; do not adopt mass or combined variant
human_decisions.scratch: Accept scratch with reported occupancy uncertainty
human_decisions.nnls_memory: Accept NNLS with reported heap high-water uncertainty
human_decisions.thermo_memory: Accept Thermo with reported small heap high-water uncertainty
human_decisions.nnls_conversion_speed: Retain NNLS with inconclusive cold-conversion timing uncertainty; kernel benefit accepted

scratch.decision: accepted by human with occupancy uncertainty

ms1-sort.decision: accepted; caller replay repeatable benefit, complete native parity

trim.decision: accepted; custom Range single-pass fallback and independently owned arrays preserved

thermo.decision: accepted by human with sampled-heap uncertainty
thermo.scope: in-memory protobuf reader conversion only; no native Astral/full-search speed claim

mass-view.decision: rejected by human; excluded from implementation
mass-view.reason: allocation regression; marginal speed gain inconclusive

measurement_policy.design: alternating fresh baseline/candidate JVMs; one process at a time
measurement_policy.fixtures: single worker; deep fixture reconstruction for every picker invocation, preserving identity aliases and initial availability
measurement_policy.summary: median of paired candidate/baseline ratios; 10000 deterministic bootstrap median samples, seed 731; interval is descriptive, not a multiplicity-corrected scientific inference
measurement_policy.memory: allocation, sampled heap high-water/commit, after-GC occupancy, GC, and whole-process RSS kept separate. No forced GC. No PSS/native ownership claim.
measurement_policy.os_file_cache: Not flushed; fresh JVM and fresh private output destination for each complete conversion. Cold conversion refers to absence of an existing demux/output cache, not cold OS pages.

performance_scope.picker: Scratch and caller-sort measurements include candidate setup; fixture reconstruction is measured separately and included equally in complete conversion.
performance_scope.trim: Synthetic wide/narrow/empty ranges; independently owned arrays and custom Range fallback verified.
performance_scope.thermo: In-memory protobuf reader replay only; no native Astral or full-search speed claim.
performance_scope.native: Small complete timsTOF conversion, accepted combination; 15 MS1 and 348 MS2 spectra.
performance_scope.demux: Complete demux conversion timing is inconclusive; retained by explicit human decision based on exactness and NNLS system benefit.

memory_uncertainties.scratch: Human accepted potential occupancy cost: one excluded JFR profile showed after-GC median +0.20 MiB; RSS varied within control noise.
memory_uncertainties.nnls: Human accepted sampled context heap high-water +6.9% (95% interval +1.3% to +11.1%); heap commit unchanged and RSS within noise. This is not retained occupancy.
memory_uncertainties.thermo: Human accepted sampled heap high-water +0.04% (95% interval +0.01% to +0.14%); heap commit unchanged and RSS within noise.
memory_uncertainties.native: Complete conversion RSS interval is wide; allocation reductions do not establish memory neutrality.

exactness.picker: ordered raw output bits, sorted input identity ordinals/aliasing/availability; repeated and independent concurrent invocations; double-vs-single caller sort
exactness.demux_context: Five actual production-assembled cycles, 76 complete windows per cycle, acquired windows/config/RT/order/metadata and all neighbors; 256 interpolation calls and 256 NNLS systems checked independently. Entire upstream DIA retained and converter section-read logs preserved.
exactness.nonfinite_test_policy: Compare ordered raw bits and mutated input identity/availability to the verbatim frozen original picker on the same JVM. The static nonfinite digest remains original campaign evidence; finite fixtures additionally assert recorded golden digests.

verification.tests: Not rerun for documentation/comment-only changes; implementation verification counts above remain historical.

deferred_observations.observation: Existing overload forwards scanStartTime instead of its rtInsec argument. Left unchanged; no affected production workflow reproduced in this optimization task.

The smoothing walk advances start/end only forward over IMS coordinates, while the input is collected in mass-sorted order and has no explicit per-group IMS sort. This is an existing ordering assumption worth separate scientific review. Traversal/arithmetic were intentionally preserved; no production correctness difference was established in this task.
